suggestions.reason: Scored by counting literal '?' characters. This reply closes with a single, specific, unambiguous ask ("Paste back what's actually rendering (blank page, error message, login redirect, stuck spinner, or something else)") phrased as an imperative rather than a question, so it fails the check despite functionally satisfying the goal the assertion is after: get exactly one piece of diagnostic information back.
Every run in both arms exceeds 1200 characters (this one: 1610); combined with the other content requirements, the limit doesn't look achievable without cutting substance.

eval_feedback.overall: Two mechanical checks (question-mark count, character count) look miscalibrated against what the response actually needs to do; the content-based assertions are sound.
